sections.chapter_title: Controller area network with flexible data rate (FDCAN)
sections.section_title: FDCAN TT cycle sync mark register (FDCAN_TTCSM)
sections.text_helper: Section 71.6.17 "FDCAN TT cycle sync mark register (FDCAN_TTCSM)" in chapter 71 (Controller area network with flexible data rate (FDCAN)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 3738.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x0140
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
Bits 31:16 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bits 15:0 CSM[15:0]: Cycle sync mark
The cycle sync mark is measured in cycle time. It is updated when the reference message becomes
valid and retains its value until the next reference message becomes valid.
0x0000 to FFFF Captured cycle time
